The '''A.9a adrenal stimulator''' was an [[Adrenal implant/Legends|adrenal implant]] sold by [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam MedTech]] for 2,250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Like other such implants, the A.9a stimulated the body's production of [[epinephrine]], thereby reducing the time needed to recover from fatigue.<ref name="LoNH" />
